current.jp: 火にあたりながらすわっていた。
current.kana: ひにあたりながらすわっていた。

structure_explanation.en: Again the target 〜ながら of simultaneity: あたり (stem of あたる, here 'to warm oneself / to draw near to the heat') + ながら = あたりながら ('while warming oneself'). 火に marks the fire as the source of the heat ('by the fire'). The main action is すわっていた ('was/were sitting'), formed by すわる in the て form + いる ('to be') + た (past), i.e., a continuous state in the past. Structure: [火に + simultaneous action ながら] + [main state ていた].
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Novamente o alvo 〜ながら de simultaneidade: あたり (radical de あたる, aqui '(se) aquecer / chegar perto do calor') + ながら = あたりながら ('enquanto se aquecia'). 火に marca o fogo como fonte do calor à qual se expõe ('junto ao fogo'). A ação principal é すわっていた ('estava(m) sentado(s)'), formada por すわる na forma て + いる ('estar') + た (passado), ou seja, um estado contínuo no passado. Estrutura: [火に + ação simultânea ながら] + [estado principal ていた].

translation_literal.en: While warming [myself] by the fire, I was sitting.

translation.pt-BR: Ficávamos sentados nos aquecendo perto do fogo.

gloss.en: to warm oneself / to come close to the heat (of the fire)
gloss.pt-BR: aquecer-se / chegar perto do calor (do fogo)

note.en: stem (連用形) of あたる, joined to ながら → あたりながら
note.pt-BR: radical (連用形) de あたる, ligado a ながら → あたりながら

gloss.en: to sit down / to be seated

note.en: て-form (促音便) of すわる → すわって, linking to いる
note.pt-BR: forma て (促音便) de すわる → すわって, ligando a いる

note.en: いる in the base い, forming すわっていた ('was sitting')
note.pt-BR: いる na base い, formando すわっていた ('estava sentado')

current.jp: 運悪く電話が故障していた。
current.kana: うんわるくでんわがこしょうしていた。

structure_explanation.en: The adverbial expression 運悪く (literally 'bad luck' = 'unfortunately, by bad luck') opens the sentence modifying the whole utterance. The core is 故障していた: the noun 故障 (breakdown/malfunction) becomes a verb with する, and 〜ていた (te-form + いる in the past) expresses a continuous state in the past ('was broken/out of order'). It is a coverage sentence, with no single grammar point in focus.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A expressão adverbial 運悪く (literalmente 'sorte ruim' = 'infelizmente, por azar') abre a frase modificando todo o enunciado. O núcleo é 故障していた: o substantivo 故障 (defeito/avaria) vira verbo com する, e 〜ていた (forma て + いる no passado) expressa um estado contínuo no passado ('estava quebrado/com defeito'). É uma frase de cobertura, sem ponto gramatical único em foco.

translation_literal.en: As luck would have it, the telephone was out of order.

translation.pt-BR: Por azar, o telefone estava com defeito.

role.en: noun (part of the adverbial expression 運悪く)
role.pt-BR: substantivo (parte da expressão adverbial 運悪く)

gloss.pt-BR: mal, de forma ruim (aqui: por azar)

note.en: adverbial form (く) of the i-adjective 悪い
note.pt-BR: forma adverbial (く) do adjetivo-i 悪い

role.en: noun that forms the verb (notional object of する)
role.pt-BR: substantivo que forma o verbo (objeto nocional de する)

gloss.en: to do (forms 故障する = 'to malfunction, to break down')

note.pt-BR: forma 連用形 de する ligada a て

note.en: いる in 連用形 base, forming 〜ていた in the past = continuous state
note.pt-BR: いる na base 連用形, formando 〜ていた no passado = estado continuo

current.jp: われわれはきっと試合に勝てると考えていた。
current.kana: われわれわきっとしあいにかてるとかんがえていた。

structure_explanation.en: Topic われわれは ('we'). Adverb きっと ('surely') expresses conviction. Thought content 試合に勝てる ('to be able to win the match'), 勝てる the potential of 勝つ ('to win') and に marking what is won (the match, 試合). と quotes this, linking to 考える ('to think'), as 考えていた (て+いる in past) = 'we were thinking/believed'.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O tópico é われわれは ("nós"). O advérbio きっと ("com certeza") expressa convicção. O conteúdo do pensamento é 試合に勝てる ("conseguir vencer a partida"), onde 勝てる é a forma potencial de 勝つ ("vencer") e に marca o oponente/alvo (試合). A partícula と cita esse conteúdo, ligando-o ao verbo 考える ("pensar/achar"), que aparece como 考えていた (て+いる no passado) = "estávamos pensando/achávamos".

translation_literal.en: As for us, we were sure we could win the match.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Nós quanto-a, com-certeza a-partida em poder-vencer que estávamos-pensando.

translation.pt-BR: Nós tínhamos certeza de que conseguiríamos vencer a partida.

gloss.en: to be able to win, to manage to win

note.en: potential form of 勝つ ("to win") → 勝てる
note.pt-BR: forma potencial de 勝つ ("vencer") → 勝てる

gloss.en: to think, to believe, to consider

note.en: て form of 考える (考えて)
note.pt-BR: forma て de 考える (考えて)

note.en: いる in continuous form, then in the past with た
note.pt-BR: いる em forma contínua, depois no passado com た

objections.objection: The op's defect (calling 試合 the 'opponent' of 勝つ) was fixed only in expl_en, which now reads "に marking what is won (the match, 試合)". expl_pt still reads "に marca o oponente/alvo (試合)", so the category error survives in the locale learners actually read, and the two explanations now teach different analyses of the same に. Half-applied fix plus an en/pt divergence introduced by the patch.
objections.auditor_hint: ...onde 勝てる é a forma potencial de 勝つ ("vencer") e に marca aquilo que se vence (a partida, 試合).

current.jp: ロッジはひぎめでかりられる。
current.kana: ろっじわひぎめでかりられる。

structure_explanation.en: The topic is ロッジ (the lodge/cabin), marked by は. The expression 日極め (ひぎめ, 'by the day / daily') indicates the basis of the rental and takes で. The target is 〜られる (rareru) on the verb 借りる (to rent): かり + られる = 借りられる, here in the potential sense 'can be rented / is possible to rent.' Note: the original is Note: the original avoids kanji, writing ひぎめ for 日極め ('by the day') and かりられる for 借りられる..

O alvo é 〜られる (rareru) sobre o verbo 借りる (alugar): かり + られる = 借りられる, aqui no sentido potencial 'pode ser alugado / é possível alugar'. Observação: o original está Observação: o original não usa kanji, escrevendo ひぎめ para 日極め ('por diária') e かりられる para 借りられる..

current.jp: リムジンはどこですか。
current.kana: りむじんわどこですか。

structure_explanation.en: The structure is the basic question pattern with [Topic] は [interrogative word] です か. リムジン (limousine) is the topic marked by は, and the question revolves around どこ (where / which place), exactly the target. です is the polite copula ('is/located') and the final particle か turns the sentence into a question. Literally: 'As for the limousine, where is it?'.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A estrutura é o padrão básico de pergunta com [Tópico] は [palavra interrogativa] です か. リムジン (limusine) é o tópico marcado por は, e a pergunta gira em torno de どこ (onde / que lugar), exatamente o foco-alvo. です é a cópula educada ('é/fica') e a partícula final か transforma a frase em pergunta. Literalmente: 'Quanto à limusine, onde é?'.

translation_literal.en: As for the limousine, where is it?

translation.pt-BR: Onde fica o ônibus do aeroporto?

gloss.en: limousine (luxury car; here in the sense of airport shuttle van)
gloss.pt-BR: limusine (carro de luxo; aqui no sentido de van/transporte de aeroporto)

note.en: polite form of the copula だ
